items: Industry mein GC quality control (maal ka mayaar check karna) aur environmental protection (mahol ki hifazat) ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Maslan petrochemical plants is se fuels ki composition (banawat) jaanchte hain, aur environmental samples mein organic pollutants ki bohat thori miqdar (trace amounts) bhi dhoondte hain.

Forensic laboratories legal investigations (qanooni tehqeeqat) mein evidence (saboot) dene ke liye GC par bohat bharosa karti hain. Is se aksar khoon mein alcohol ki miqdar (blood alcohol content, BAC) ka test hota hai. Is ke ilawa GC se biological samples (khoon, peshab waghera) mein ghair qanooni drugs, zehr ya performance barhane wali cheezein dhoondi jati hain.

Food aur beverage (khane aur peene ki cheezon ki) industry GC se apni cheezon ki consistency (har baar aik jaisa hona) aur safety yaqeeni banati hai. Bacteria ya fungi ke metabolic byproducts (un ke bane hue maadde) pehchan kar GC kharabi (spoilage) ko aankh se nazar aane se pehle hi pakar leti hai. GC se perfumes, essential oils aur khurak ke flavours ki complex aromatic profiles (khushbu ki banawat) bhi jaanchi jati hai.

Hospitals waghera (clinical settings) mein GC mareez ki saans ya peshab ke khaas compounds jaanch kar metabolic disorders (jism ke chemical kaamon ki bimariyan) ki diagnosis (bimari ki pehchan) karti hai. Dawa ki research mein bhi is se nayi banayi gayi dawaiyon ki purity check hoti hai, taa ke mareez tak pohnchne se pehle dawa mein koi harmful (nuqsan deh) bacha hua solvent ya impurity na rahe.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Forensic science mein chromatography ahem hai. China mein Nian Bin naam ke aik aadmi par 2005 mein ilzaam laga ke us ne do parosi bachchon ki khurak mein chooha maar zehr (aik fluoroacetate) mila kar unhein qatl kiya. Lekin 8 saal baad, 2013 mein, woh be-qasoor sabit hua aur rihaa kar diya gaya. Khurak ke sample ko gas chromatography se test kiya gaya, jis ne sabit kiya ke us mein zehr nahi mila tha.
